content:
{
  "robotWalk": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: robot-walk-remediation.png. Create ONLY corrected Robot Walk as transparent 2x2 four-frame sprite sheet. Preserve exact teal tin wind-up robot identity, yellow smiling square face, red boots and gloves, gold key, painted textured shading and soft illustrated contours from target. Same camera facing right in all frames, same torso dimensions, same scale, same baseline and generous gap/padding. Frame A top-left: LEFT leg forward, grounded supporting weight, RIGHT leg back. Frame B top-right: passing pose, right knee visibly swings forward past supporting left leg, torso rises. Frame C bottom-left: RIGHT leg forward grounded support, LEFT leg visibly back; absolutely opposite leading leg compared to A, distinguish front leg depth by knee and boot orientation. Frame D bottom-right: passing pose with left knee swinging forward, weight on right leg. Torso subtly shifts with transfer. Natural A-B-C-D-A loop. No running, no attacks, no arm pointing, no dust or effects, no text, no background, no shadows detached from feet, no new components, no outlines thicker than original. Critical: C must reverse the limb phase of A rather than repeat the near boot forward. Keep painted repository technique; do not turn into vector or pixel art.",
  "rocketPunch": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target image 1 Rocket Punch sprite sheet; style reference image 2 is original robot retro-robot-v1.png. Correct only the rendering finish of Rocket Punch to original small painted tin-toy style: softer dark brown thin contours instead of thick black vector ink, muted textured turquoise metal and warm brass, soft worn shading, compact original robot proportions. Preserve ALL six poses in exact same 3 columns by 2 rows layout, same facing right, same pose timing and fist extension lengths, spring segments, red gloves/boots, smiling yellow panel, gold winding key, antenna. Do not redesign or add joints. All torso centerlines and grounded foot baselines stay at the SAME positions as target. Full transparent background, remove detached glows/effects, no text. Make changes confined to surface rendering, not pose, silhouette or scale. Frame3/4 must still read as telescopic Rocket Punch without effects. Avoid glossy plastic, vector icons, thick outlines, oversized head, cropping.",
  "trainWalk": "Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the wheel eccentric pins and red connecting rod in the provided six-frame toy train Walk sheet, preserve every other pixel/art detail, body position, proportions, palette, textured painterly material and all six facing-right train poses and 3x2 layout. Make a mechanically correct six-phase crank cycle clockwise: frame1 0 degrees right of hub, frame2 60 degrees below-right, frame3 120 degrees below-left, frame4 180 degrees left, frame5 240 degrees above-left, frame6 300 degrees above-right. In EACH frame both large drive wheels have identical eccentric phase and identical radius exactly about one third of wheel radius. Rod endpoints attach precisely to those pins, rod remains parallel to line joining axle hubs and constant length from frame to frame. Keep central axle hub visible separately from eccentric moving pin so rotation is legible without dust. Close loop naturally 6 to1. No rod attached to hub center, no disconnected rod or changed wheel size, no extra wheels, no effects or new parts. Preserve transparent background and original train identity.",
  "steamBlast": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: six frame Steam Blast toy train sheet. Preserve same painted wood toy, blue cylindrical boiler, red cab/chimney, green tender, brass front disc and wheels, same scale, right-facing camera and 3x2 layout. Improve ONLY emission anticipation. NO steam, glow, smoke, dust or special effects in ANY frame. Six poses: 1 neutral identical to current1; 2 load pressure: boiler visibly compresses backward against cab, chassis dips over loaded wheels, front circular brass pressure valve slightly retracts; 3 braced firing pose: boiler strains forward, brass front valve swings visibly OPEN off the round front port, chimney mouth opens, mechanical tension obvious; 4 release: recoil backwards/upwards from the open front port, chassis rocked, do NOT turn this into a charge; 5 valve visibly recloses as chassis settles;6 returns exactly towardneutral. Maintain overall size/proportions and preserve connected wheels and rod. Ground reference fixed, no body teleporting horizontally; subtle compression inside body only. Critical: first three frames must clearly communicate preparing to expel pressure even with no vapor. Use existing brass disk as valve, no new gun or new attack. Transparent background, no text, original textured paint rather than vector.",
  "laserBeam": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit ONLY six-frame Laser Beam animation in target image 1. Keep original robot body, face, antenna, winding key, teal metal, red gloves/boots, yellow brass and painted textured technique; style reference original robot image2. Preserve 3x2 six-frame layout, character scale and torso-ground anchors. Facing right in ALL frames. NO beams, glow, energy, particles or effects anywhere. Pose1 neutral same as source. Pose2 plant legs, rotate torso and head to aim RIGHT, raise near forearm forward to right at chest height, far arm braces it. Pose3 clear firing anticipation: extend forearm firmly to RIGHT, open red glove into forward-facing palm with fingers drawn back, left hand supports wrist, torso locked and slightly braced backward. Pose4 release posture with same open palm aimed RIGHT, small elbow/torso recoil; no punching spring and no gun. Pose5 close hand and relax elbow. Pose6 return neutral. Body motion/readability must say ranged firing preparation even without laser. Avoid pointing the firing arm left behind the robot, symmetric arms spread as idle, new equipment, oversized head, vector outlines, changed identity, cropping, horizontal torso jumps. Transparent background and full parts."
}
